baseline.result: Real Android 16 WebView reproduced AF-E10 before any commit: accessibility text Ask ChatGPT\n, selection 1:1, empty hint metadata; IME text \n, selection 0:0, offset=-1, absolute selection 0:0. Actual alien tap and focus binding succeeded; delivered=false.

cause: Accessibility presentation includes CSS-generated placeholder content and can use different text/cursor coordinates from the actual input buffer. Comparing those representations as an edit prerequisite rejects a legitimate keyboard connection.
repair: Keyboard input exclusively owns text and coordinates for keyboard range edits. Accessibility identifies the same focused, non-protected field. Offset=-1 uses an immutable IME selection surviving the read and matching selection width. Validate every shared keyboard character and all characters in the mutation before a single dispatch; confirm through that same API. Bounded appends remain possible; unseen revisions/cancel are rejected. Typing protects dispatched speech and reanchors its future tail without stopping capture. Keep a guarded node-action fallback for positively empty fields without a keyboard connection.

integration.environment: API 36 x86_64 disposable emulator; Gboard; WebView 133.0.6943.137; official Termux 0.118.3 x86_64
integration.browser: Actual overlay taps, real accessibility broker/IME IPC and DOM observations: empty rich editor, live final revision, selected replacement preserving draft anchors, real keyboard typing while dictation stays active, future speech tail, repeated Unicode session.
integration.termux: Actual installed terminal echo: final text once after Stop, no premature partial text or Enter, repeated terminal session, live ordinary field after terminal, then return to terminal.
integration.boundary: Transcript and capture-readiness fixtures; microphone and paid provider not exercised.
